title: Docs: Add the new code coverage check for contributors and reviewers
author: adiati98
body:
## Description

This PR updates the developer contribution guide and code governance page to reflect the automated code coverage check recently added to Mautic core's PR workflow based on comments in PR https://github.com/mautic/mautic/pull/16697.

### Changes

* `docs/contributing/developer.rst`
  * **Step 6: Writing tests** - adds guidance that contributions must maintain or improve code coverage, and that contributors can ask a triage team member to add the `check-coverage` label at a later review stage to confirm coverage is sufficient.
  * **PR review process** - adds a step for reviewers to add the `check-coverage` label when a PR reaches a later review stage.
* `docs/governance/code_governance.rst`
  * Adds `Check coverage` to the **Status-based labels** list.
  * Updates the `Ready to commit` label's criteria to include passing the code coverage check.

### Live preview

- https://mautic-community-handbook--447.org.readthedocs.build/en/447/contributing/developer.html#writing-tests
- https://mautic-community-handbook--447.org.readthedocs.build/en/447/governance/code_governance.html#status-based-labels
